title: Red Hat Security Advisory: gcc-toolset-16-gcc security update
description: Multiple security vulnerabilities have been identified in the gcc-toolset-16-gcc package, which contains GNU Compiler Collection version 16. These include an integer wrap, confirmed out-of-bounds read/write, stack overflow, and out-of-bounds read issues affecting libstdc++ components. Red Hat has issued a security advisory rating the impact as moderate and has released updates to address these issues for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10 on various architectures.
